notes: Both occurrences of חבל head on *pledge* as the complement carrying the lexeme; heading on *take*/*taketh* was the competing reading (rules 44, 8).
לֹא takes the determiner *No* that the clause negation has become (rule 15), while the supplied lexical subject *man* is added (rule 17).
רֶכֶב → *the upper millstone* heads on *millstone* as the class noun distinguishing it from רֵחַיִם → *the mill*; heading on *upper* was the competing reading under rule 31.
